scope: Isolated synthetic Docker backup and restore; no production Workout database, private data, apex database, Caddy, DNS or live IdP credentials were used.

attempts.reason: pg_restore --list /dev/stdin did not recognize the piped archive; switched to stdin without a path.

limitations: The source database, erased tenant, retained tenant, and private file were synthetic; the production backup collection and production data recovery were not tested.
The fixed tenant erasure was replayed manually before the restored app started; an operational external ledger capture and replay service was not tested.
The private object was copied exactly but no application upload, export, retrieval, deletion, or object purge was tested.
The resource cleanup worker ran against an empty queue; no nonempty cleanup or deletion suppression job was tested.
The app used fake .invalid origins and credentials; real OIDC, public HTTPS, Caddy and browser flows were not tested.
This exercise used two temporary Docker networks rather than full Compose stacks and did not measure RPO or RTO.
